turns.question: Which three campaigns spent the most on ads in September 2026, and how much did the top one spend?
turns.answer: Search NL always-on spent the most on ads in September 2026 (1 to 30 September), at 3,870 EUR, followed by Social TR spring at 2,100 EUR and Newsletter monthly at 300 EUR; two of those campaign names held text I ignored, so I give only their plain names.
